c8c77aa6-99ca-471d-a7ed-807957a3a168.text: Free, browser-based apps for K-16 classrooms

eb2f9f5e-8fb8-497e-961d-68f33f00913c.text: The SplatWorks family: GridSplat, ShowSplat, WriteSplat, ListSplat, and LayoutSplat, alongside the DrawSplat whiteboard.

80e03457-0d31-4033-a6c7-fdd576602aeb.text:
SplatWorks is a family of browser-based office apps for classrooms, built by the DrawSplat project. It serves educators, school technology admins, parents, and students.

The apps run without creating an account or installing a database. Browser autosave keeps work on your device, so export project files regularly. Files can be exchanged with Microsoft Office and LibreOffice formats; keep your originals and check conversions.

76392355-0425-4cf7-826f-6506a43de457.text: This newsletter was built in LayoutSplat.

a9d18de3-1efc-468a-bd9d-ffa6ef566f52.text: A self-contained interactive whiteboard for K-16 educators and students

4d7cda79-8a6f-46e7-a2ae-6ed208e6b5bd.text: DrawSplat at a glance: panels, teacher layers, graphs, concept maps, templates, collaboration, export, and storage options.

e5ce7059-24b3-4d02-93ae-a69ea8ef7b0f.text:
• Switch between Simple and Advanced interface modes.
• Use multiple panels for stations, lesson steps, and group work.
• Draw and add shapes, text, sticky notes, images, connectors, comments, and audio notes.
• Build graphs, concept maps, word clouds, GIFs, and Mermaid diagrams.
• Lock teacher layers and use assignment mode, student mode, and answer keys.
• Export boards as PNG or PDF.

3a211e61-4496-4f15-ad3c-20202d972ff2.text:
• Browser-only: autosaves in the current browser, with no server or accounts.
• Google Drive via Apps Script: cross-device saving, cloud rooms, templates, and turn-ins.
• MariaDB/MySQL: private, account-owned online Save/Open.
• Restore points and file backups add a safety net.

1e611d9c-3f25-4ac1-bba3-841ada9998ce.text:
